final: WITH customer_totals AS (SELECT c.state_county_province AS state, SUM(t.transaction_amount) AS total FROM Financial_Transactions t JOIN Invoices i ON i.invoice_number = t.invoice_number JOIN Orders o ON o.order_id = i.order_id JOIN Customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.state_county_province), shares AS (SELECT state, total, total * 1.0 / SUM(total) OVER () AS share FROM customer_totals), above_average AS (SELECT total, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS avg_share FROM shares) SELECT SUM(total) AS combined_transaction_total, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(share - avg_share) AS average_excess_share FROM above_average WHERE share > avg_share
